summary: Premtek International Inc. is a distributor of equipment and consumables for the semiconductor, optoelectronics, and PCB industries, focusing on providing integrated service solutions. The company offers a variety of specialized equipment, including rapid thermal processing systems and plasma cleaning tools, aimed at enhancing manufacturing efficiency and quality.
